legacyWasm.scope: All API-exposed W1 output/body/clock fields compared on the same actual WASM backend. Native full diagnostics and pointer preservation are a separate corpus. The SDK profile explicitly uses its8192 contact cap; the zero-duration case is a host rejection, not a model result.

reference.scope: Exact rational initial/prefix/whole-cell/point/entry-width and last-mesh references; structural traversal/work audit, not an independent measurement of executed instructions or injected exceptional work.

mathematicalCorpus.scope: All model DTO fields first matched to pure Native bits. The 62 decoder-derived complete model DTOs are projected into the pinned 65-input mathematical corpus; the three exchange-rejected pure Native results are explicitly supplemented, never claimed as WASM model results. The 62-only file is an artifact, not falsely presented as accepted by the pinned checker.

oldEntryOwned.scope: Actual shared WASM through the public owned JavaScript entry decoder. Counts are complete DTO comparisons, separate from earlier Native/raw-WASM wire counts. Read-only defined-segment guard; no UI, World, TOI, contact response, or allocation/unknown-work exception injection.
